Chandelure

Ghost Fire

Unova · Generation 5

Chandelure is a Ghost/Fire-type Luring Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 34.3 kg. It evolves from Lampent. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (145), with a base stat total of 520.
